# Vendored Dear ImGui

- Upstream: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui
- Version: v1.92.1
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE.txt`)

Trimmed to only what this project builds against: the core sources plus the
Win32 and DX11 backends. Examples, docs, other backends, upstream CI workflows,
and `imgui_demo.cpp` were removed. No source modifications.
